'''Yerk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he worked as a merchant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CodexHutta">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutta}}</ref> On Hutta he owned a small stall in the market area of [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an industrial town controlled by a Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="CodexJiguuna">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> The stall consisted of a shelves of various goods which he sold, which included specialist types of [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> As all merchants in Jiguuna were, Yerk was expected to pay some of his profits from his stall to one of Nem'ro's lieutenants at the crime lord's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]].<ref name="CodexNem'roP">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nem'ro's palace}}</ref> Whilst at the stall the man wore light brown armor and a backpack. Yerk had [[Color/Legends|black]] hair including a moustache, blue eyes and tanned skin.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yerk first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears as a specialist items vendor on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] class. Instead of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Yerk's items have prices in Nal Hutta commendations, a separate currency used for specialist equipment available as rare drops from enemies or from quest completion. He was removed from the game in update 6.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.<ref name="Patch notes">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1292020/game-update-6.2|text=Game Update 6.2}}</ref> He was later brought back to the game in update 7.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 7.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/08022022/game-update-7.1-digging-deeper|text=Game Update 7.1: Digging Deeper Patch Notes}}</ref>
